captions.detailed: A tall, narrow, tower-format outdoor-rated air purifier. It features a light gray rectangular main body with filleted corners, resting on a flat, black rectangular base. The top section consists of a matching black square cap elevated on four small corner pillars to allow for air intake or exhaust. One side of the body is equipped with a dark vertical control panel or sensor module.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a tall, narrow tower-format outdoor air purifier. The model must feature a light gray main body with rounded corners, a flat black base, and a black square top cap elevated on four small corner supports. Include a dark-colored rectangular panel along one of the flat vertical faces.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first creating a rounded rectangular extrusion for the main body and coloring it light gray. A thin, flat rectangular plate is generated at the bottom for the base, colored dark gray or black. At the top, a series of small cylinders are placed at the corners to act as supports, and a flat square plate with filleted corners is placed on top of them to form the protective cap. Finally, a thin rectangular box is added to one side of the body to represent the control panel interface.
